Generated by tools/build_shorthand.py from translations/*.th.json, with reviewed runtime reservations. Each cluster or phrase entry is expanded from a single byte; adding or removing one changes every encoded string, so rebuild the ROM after regenerating. Low-use clusters omitted here donate their fixed codes to dialogue_primary_glyphs in encoding.json, keeping mixed Thai/English dialogue entirely on C1. Four clusters were also given back when the weapon attribute badges ///

took four spacing codes. The final cluster slot is reserved for the phrase โล่; ปิ is deliberately emitted as two ordinary component bytes instead.
